old_caption:
The video captures a dynamic scene at the ocean where several surfers are engaged in their activities. The first frame shows two individuals on surfboards, one actively riding a wave while the other appears to be paddling or waiting for a wave. The waves are moderate in size, creating white foam as they break near the shore.

In the second frame, the perspective shifts slightly, revealing more surfers in the water. One surfer is seen standing on a board, skillfully maneuvering through the waves, while others are either paddling or lying on their boards, possibly preparing to catch a wave. The ocean's surface is textured with ripples and small waves, indicating a lively yet manageable surfing environment.

The third frame continues to showcase the surfing activity, with a different group of surfers visible. Multiple individuals are in the water, some paddling and others lying on their boards, with one surfer actively riding a wave. The scene remains active with waves breaking near the shore.

caption: The video captures an open ocean under a pale clear sky, with lines of breaking waves and white foam. In the first view, two people in dark wetsuits are in the shore break. One crouches in the churning whitewater while another, nearer the camera, stands in the shallow wash holding a white surfboard painted with teal and red panels. A second, wider view shows a line-up of several surfers. In the mid-distance, a person in a dark wetsuit lies prone on a board before pushing up and rising to stand. Other surfers sit or float behind the breaking foam, one holding a white board at the left, others bobbing mid-frame and at the right. The standing surfer rides the breaking wave toward the camera, growing larger in frame while shifting from the left toward the center, arms outstretched for balance. The foam lines advance shoreward, while the foreground surfers drift only slightly with the wash as the clip runs.

draft_caption: The video captures an open ocean under a pale clear sky, with lines of breaking waves and white foam. In the first view, two people in dark wetsuits sit in the shore break. One crouches on a board inside the churning whitewater while another, nearer the camera, holds upright on a white surfboard painted with teal and red panels. A second, wider view then shows a line-up of several surfers. In the mid-distance, a person in a dark wetsuit lies prone on a board before pushing up into a kneeling posture and rising to stand. Other surfers sit or float in the foreground foam, one holding a white board at the left, others bobbing mid-frame and at the right. The standing surfer rides the breaking wave toward the camera, growing larger in frame while shifting from the left toward the center, arms outstretched for balance. The foam lines advance shoreward and the crest keeps breaking lower, while the foreground surfers drift only slightly with the wash as the clip runs.
